name: api_openai_gpt_image_2_5_edit_2img
description: OpenAI GPT Image 2.5 image edit with two reference images plus a text instruction. Use for compositing a subject into a scene, transferring a style, or combining elements from both. Runs through the OpenAIGPTImageNodeV2 partner node, which needs ComfyUI v0.35.0 or newer, against your local ComfyUI; billed to your Comfy account (the comfy_cloud API key from `slop-studio auth --comfy-cloud`), not an OpenAI key. aspect_ratio sets an exact custom size of about 1-1.6 MP (1:1 = 1024x1024, 16:9 = 1536x864, 21:9 = 1680x720); omit it and the model picks the size ('auto'). Output carries an alpha channel when background is 'transparent'. OpenAI's backend ignores the seed, so reruns of the same prompt will differ.

prompt.description: Edit instruction that refers to the references as 'image 1' and 'image 2', e.g. 'put the character from image 1 into the room from image 2'.

image1.description: First reference image ('image 1' in the prompt).

image2.description: Second reference image ('image 2' in the prompt).

model.description: Which GPT Image 2.5 variant to run: 'flare' (default) is fast and suits most work; 'sunburst' is slower but more precise, especially across edits.

quality.description: Render quality: 'low', 'medium', 'high' (default), 'xhigh' or 'max'. Cost and time rise with each tier, since billing is by output tokens; use 'low' for drafts.

background.description: Background handling: 'auto' (default), 'opaque', or 'transparent' for a PNG cut-out with an alpha channel (say so in the prompt too, e.g. 'isolated on a transparent background').
